Gene Summary dumpy ( dpy ) encodes an extracellular protein involved in epidermal-cuticle attachment, aposition of wing surfaces and trachea development. [Date last reviewed: 2019-09-26] ( FlyBase Gene Snapshot )
Also Known As dp, SP460
Genomic Location and Detailed Mapping Data Chromosome (arm) 2L Recombination map 2-13 Cytogenetic map 24F4-25A1 Sequence location 2L:4,477,462..4,614,300
Automated gene summary (FlyBase API, FB2026_03): The gene dumpy is referred to in FlyBase by the symbol Dmel\dpy (CG33196, FBgn0053196). It is a protein_coding_gene from Dmel. It has 16 annotated transcripts and 16 polypeptides (all unique). Gene sequence location is 2L:4477462..4614300. Its molecular function is described by: zinc ion binding; extracellular matrix structural constituent; calcium ion binding. It is involved in the biological process described with: chitin-based cuticle attachment to epithelium; regulation of imaginal disc-derived wing size; chitin-based embryonic cuticle biosynthetic process; open tracheal system development; apposition of dorsal and ventral imaginal disc-derived wing surfaces. 335 alleles are reported. The phenotypes of these alleles manifest in: pleurum; eo sensory organ accessory cell; adult external head; muscle attachment site; procuticle. The phenotypic classes of alleles include: phenotype; lethal; abnormal size; modifier of variegation. Summary of modENCODE Temporal Expression Profile:  Temporal profile ranges from a peak of moderate expression to a trough of extremely low expression.  Peak expression observed within 06-24 hour embryonic stages, at stages throughout the larval period, at stages throughout the pupal period, in stages of adults of both sexes.
